description: This file defines the ADODB2_sqlite class, which provides SQLite-specific implementations for data dictionary operations within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes methods for type mapping, altering columns, dropping columns, and renaming columns, tailored to SQLite's capabilities.

classes.name: ADODB2_sqlite
classes.description: Provides SQLite-specific database schema manipulation methods within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps custom or generic metadata types to SQLite-specific data types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix clauses for column definitions based on field attributes.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Intended to generate SQL for altering a column but indicates native support is lacking in SQLite.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Intended to generate SQL for dropping a column but indicates native support is lacking in SQLite.

methods.name: RenameColumnSQL
methods.description: Intended to generate SQL for renaming a column but indicates native support is lacking in SQLite.
